name: doodad-turn-we
description: The turn and nudge keys and the palette on doodads, with Snap Doodads on Load (input: make-doodad-snap.mjs turn, doodad-turn.w3x: on their grids at 270 degrees a 4x4 ring picture D200, a 2x2 diagonal D201 and a plain 4x4 D202, destructables B100 (no texture, fixed rotation 90), B102 (2x2, fixed rotation 90) and B101 (no texture, none) at 0.4). WE: each box-selected, number pad / once (ring: 270 to 0, a quarter), twice (diagonal: 270 to 90), once (plain: 275, by the step); number pad 6 on each destructable (B100 and B101 move 8 with their angle left at 22.9, B102 moves 64 to the next grid point, angle 90); a B100 and a B102 from the Doodad palette at about 500,650 / 750,650 of the display (B100 gets a random angle, not its fixed 90; B102 its 90). Studio: the same by its selection keys and place_objects. Ignored: the placed ones' variation and scale and the B100's angle (random in both; the Studio step checks the angle isn't 90). Expected MATCH

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const key = async (k, code) => { const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: k, code, bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); }; const go = async (id, x, y, k, code, n) => { await s.look.get('map/war3map.w3e.txt')(x, y, { id, x, y }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000)); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) await key(k, code); await key('Escape', 'Escape'); }; await go('D200', -768, 0, '/', 'NumpadDivide', 1); await go('D201', -224, 32, '/', 'NumpadDivide', 2); await go('D202', 256, 0, '/', 'NumpadDivide', 1); await go('B100', -768, 512, '6', 'Numpad6', 1); await go('B102', -224, 544, '6', 'Numpad6', 1); await go('B101', 256, 512, '6', 'Numpad6', 1); await w3.editors.saveAll();

const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); const o = s.placedObjects().doodads.find((d) => d.id === 'B100' && d.position[1] < 0); if (!o || Math.abs(o.angle - Math.PI / 2) < 0.001) throw new Error('a placed B100 (no texture) has its fixed rotation: ' + o?.angle); await w3.editors.saveAll();
